title: The Economics of Old Friends
sentences: Long friendships survive on a currency that is difficult to acquire later.
They contain a shared record that neither party has to summarise.
You can begin a sentence in the middle and still be understood.
Newer friendships, however warm, require constant explanation of background.
This is why people describe old friends as restful rather than exciting.
The cost is that the record includes versions of you long since abandoned.
Old friends are the last people still holding your earlier drafts.
Some of us find that reassuring and some find it quietly confining.
Both reactions are reasonable and often occur in the same person.
What cannot be manufactured at any speed is the accumulated time itself.
